dct_description_sm: Communities in coastal Labrador are now and will continue to be affected by climate variability and change. The effects of the changing climate compound other pressures and stresses that communities in which they will need to adapt. The purpose of the project was to: (1) examine what roles and values and cultural identity play in shaping responses to climate change in Labrador and; (2) provide in-depth knowledge of how values and culture are likely elements that will impact adaptation measures in Labrador communities.

dct_title_s: Assessing the Roles of Community Values and Cultural Identity in Shaping Responses to Climate Change in Labrador
